# `morphir decoration set`

- **Usage:** `morphir decoration set <FLAGS> <NAME> <TARGET>`

Add or replace one typed value at a semantic node URI

## Arguments
- **`<NAME>`** — Decoration name from the project config
- **`<TARGET>`** — Portable Morphir node URI

## Flags
- **`--config <CONFIG>`** — Project config containing the named decoration

  **Default:** `morphir.json`
- **`--ir <IR>`** — Exact V3 or V4 target IR JSON to decorate
- **`--value <VALUE>`** — File containing one JSON value
